family: All Boolean tables in dimensions 1,2,3; every one-point flip and every unordered adjacent-pair flip. All 16 two-bit seeds, tensor powers t=1,...,6. Quadratic bent seeds n=4,6,8 at vertices 0,1,2^n-1, each point and each adjacent pair.
domain: No dimension escalation. Cube encoded in binary; Walsh characters (-1)^(S dot x).
symmetry: None in small exhaustive domain. Bent checks are declared fixtures, not exhaustive or symmetry claims.
arithmetic: Integer FWHT, Fraction for spectral laws and influence; rational outward log intervals using range reduction and atanh series, 50 terms; illustrative decimal output labeled only.
pilot: Entire bounded domain; stop after 60 seconds without raising n.
